intelligence.enrichment: Magnetic separation separates magnetic and non-magnetic substances by using a magnet; iron is a common magnetic substance. A magnet attracts the magnetic component, so that component can be removed from the non-magnetic part of the mixture. The learner correctly applies this rule: Magnetic separation separates magnetic and non-magnetic substances by using a magnet; iron is a common magnetic substance. A magnet is just a faster way to pick any visible solid from a mixture.
